Maya Patel: cost-bot just flagged a big GPU delta for project=atlas-research — quarterly budget is blown by ~28% vs forecast. can we recon quickly? :eyes:
CostBot: Automatic alert: Project atlas-research exceeded cost threshold (28% over forecast) for billing cycle 2026-02. Top contributors: gpu-n1-standard-16 (preemptible), gpu-a100 (on-demand). See billing export link: https://console.cloud/billing/exports/atlas
Liam O'Connor: @maya I'm seeing a ton of preemptible A100s spun up by the research service account overnight. labels are missing project_owner and customer_tag so BigQuery grouping fell into "unallocated". low-hanging: add label enforcement and retro-assign tags where possible.
Sophia Chen: also noticed some runs hit the Dedicated pool fallback which bills to the shared account because the infra agent used the default billing account. that explains the large delta on the shared line item. we should re-run invoice allocation for feb and request a line-item move from cloud vendor.
Maya Patel: ugh. can someone paste the bq query you use to find untagged GPU usage? i want to show finance the breakdown before filing a support case.
Liam O'Connor: paste below — run on the billing export dataset, filter by resource.type=GPU and sum skus. should catch preemptible vs on-demand and missing labels.
```
SELECT
  invoice_month,
  IFNULL(labels.project_owner,'UNMAPPED') AS project_owner,
  sku_description,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-02'
  AND LOWER(sku_description) LIKE '%gpu%'
GROUP BY invoice_month, project_owner, sku_description
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 200;
```
Sophia Chen: FYI i already re-tagged ~12% of the runs via the job history (k8s audit + owner mapping). still ~16% unallocated. i'll open a PR to enforce labels on the job template.
Ethan Ramos: for the short term can finance approve a manual cost transfer from shared to atlas-research? we'll need PO and manager sign-off but vendor sometimes accepts retro adjustments.
Maya Patel: yes please — i'll draft the transfer request. need a clear justification and list of affected invoices/line items. sophia/liam can you export the CSV with line-item ids and timestamps?
Liam O'Connor: exporting now. prefix will be atlas-retrospec-202602.csv and i'll drop it in /shared/finance-temp with a note.
Sophia Chen: done — uploaded and added notes on which jobs were preemptible vs fallback. link: https://files.internal/shared/finance-temp/atlas-retrospec-202602.csv
CostBot: Note: billing export processed at 2026-03-12T03:20:15Z. Suggested action: open vendor support case referencing export file and include line-item IDs.
Maya Patel: thanks. i'll open the vendor case and cc legal. can we also add a short-term alert rule: when gpu spend per project > $12k/day for two consecutive days, notify finance + infra? want to catch this earlier next time.
Ethan Ramos: +1 for alert. also propose a soft quota on preemptible a100 per project until tagging enforcement is live. less friction than full quota.
Liam O'Connor: added an alert draft in ops-monitoring: channel #billing-alerts, severity=warn, window=48h, threshold=$12k daily on gpu sku. will push to prod after an ack from finance.
Maya Patel: ack. i'll follow up with the transfer request and vendor case number once opened. thanks everyone, that calmed down faster than i expected. :thumbsup:
